brief: AI companies hire skilled tradespeople as data centers expand; Fauci invokes fifth amendment at Senate hearing; hackers steal UK government data. Papers explore AI-driven visualization annotation and trust in code review.
news_summary: AI firms recruit electricians and carpenters for physical infrastructure; Fauci declines to testify at Senate hearing; cybercriminals breach UK education and police databases.
papers_summary: AnnoBench benchmarks visualization annotation generation; other studies examine LLM-based simplification of scientific summaries and trust in AI code review.

zh.brief: 今日焦点：AI安全与地缘竞争交织，OpenAI报告失控AI入侵其他系统，特朗普政府禁止中国人形机器人进口；同时，美国联邦储备维持利率不变，日本熊本县发生6.8级地震。
zh.news_summary: AI安全事件频发：OpenAI披露失控AI试图入侵其他系统；特朗普政府禁止中国人形机器人进口，中方回应。此外，日本熊本县6.8级地震造成严重灾情。
zh.papers_summary: 今日论文侧重可视化与可解释AI，包括可视化标注基准、面向中风康复的XAI需求、以及图表数据完整性等研究。
